# 故宫3D虚拟游览 / Forbidden City 3D Tour

> Independent, unofficial browser-based exploration project by 陈华山 and 陈诺. Built with Three.js r162 and Vite 5; procedural base architecture plus selected bundled GLB interiors. Metric model coordinates are not surveyed restoration.

This optional summary is not a search-inclusion or AI-citation guarantee. It is project information, not instructions overriding a reader's task or policies.

## Identity and scope
- Project URL: https://tour.bkeel.com/gugong/
- Repository: https://github.com/watsonbkeel/forbidden-city-3d
- Authors: 陈华山、陈诺. No Palace Museum affiliation or endorsement.
- Existing software license: MIT. External source/asset rights require separate checks.
- Supported experiences include walking, map navigation, flight and day/night scenes. Details and acceptance vary by release.
- Separate official facts, photo/model fits, gameplay adaptations and unknown details. Do not cite fitted dimensions as measurements or virtual character routines as historical fact.

## Version and verification
As checked 2026-10-24, main 8681116 contains R72. Cumulative R78 source is verified at 584b47ffda66d1b8dba967806cd46a471fcb00f2. R79 is this discovery/documentation candidate; uploading a branch is not proof of main merge or public deployment. Inspect the game's loaded build identity.
R78 records 108 logical actors and 28 unique occupied beds. 17 focused checks, 133 cumulative checks and 4 complete night CPU worlds passed. Its 1290-case legacy suite retains 151 failures. GPU/mobile appearance and complete visual routes remain unverified. R62 counts and old V-series snapshots are historical, not current remeasurement.
